name: What factors determine the cost of replacing kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of replacing kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of kitchen cabinet replacement depends on the linear footage of your kitchen, the box construction, door styles, and material grades. Stock manufactured cabinets are the most budget-friendly, while semi-custom and fully custom cabinetry tailored to unique room dimensions carry higher price points. Project scope also influences total investment: preserving your existing layout minimizes plumbing and electrical modifications, whereas reconfiguring walls, adding an island, or integrating built-in appliances increases labor, drywall preparation, and trade coordination. Inquiries and formal quotes help establish exact pricing tailored to your space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on the total linear footage, custom versus stock build quality, door styles, and whether your layout requires moving plumbing, electrical, or drywall.
